headline: AutoNation Reports Third-Quarter Revenue Beat Despite Earnings Miss
summary: AutoNation posted quarterly revenue that topped analyst estimates, though earnings per share missed expectations by $0.06.
why: Automotive retail results reflect consumer vehicle purchasing demand, pricing power, and inventory management trends.

impacts.name: AutoNation
impacts.why: An earnings miss combined with a revenue beat results in mixed fundamental signals.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A mixed earnings report featuring higher-than-expected revenue paired with an earnings per share miss created conflicting signals for investors.
